sn22.19:1.3: The cause and condition for the arising of form is also suffering.
sn22.19:1.4: As form has originated from what is suffering, how could it be happiness?
sn22.19:1.9: The cause and condition for the arising of consciousness is also suffering.
sn22.19:1.10: As consciousness has originated from what is suffering, how could it be happiness?
sn22.19:1.12: He understands: ‘… there is no more for this state of being.’ ”
